featured_reviews.name: binoy varghese
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased this stained-glass star, and it has truly exceeded my expectations. The craftsmanship is excellent — the glass panels have vibrant shades of blue and green that catch the light beautifully, giving a warm, festive glow to the entire corner of my décor. The metal framing feels sturdy and well-finished, adding to its premium look.

What I appreciate most is how effortlessly it enhances the ambiance. Whether lit or unlit, it stands out as a stunning decorative piece. The hanging chain is strong and the overall build gives a very handcrafted, artisanal feel.

It has become a perfect focal point above my nativity setup, adding just the right touch of elegance and Christmas charm. Completely worth the purchase — highly recommended for anyone looking to elevate their festive decorations!

I also want to appreciate the staff / owner  who assisted me before the purchase. She took the time to call me, patiently show a live video demo of the star, and explain the details clearly. Her  courteous approach and willingness to help gave me complete confidence in placing the order. It’s rare to experience such personalised customer service these days, and it made a big difference.

featured_reviews.name: Sanmit Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Appalled by the utter rudeness of the staff here. Courtesy, politeness and customer service are some of the qualities they are unaware of.
A retail store thrives on how it treats its customers, but the people running this place seem to have no respect for their customers.
If you expect a pleasant shopping environment and decent treatment, avoid Janata Stationery and Art store. Zero stars if I could.

featured_reviews.name: Falguni P
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was amazed with the variety of stationery, gifting options and art supplies they have.
The shop is divided into two parts. The top part has all the perfumes, chocolates, board games, office stationery, gift items.
There are pretty wall decor, bags and dream catchers.

The basement has all the art supplies like charcoal pencil, painting colours, canvas, small craft decor, colour pencils etc
The owner and staff are very helpful and courteous.

The shop is not accessible as there are stairs for entering and also to go down in the basement.
They accept digital payments.

featured_reviews.name: Shripad Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
🚫 Bad shop, bad attitude, bad experience.

I wouldn’t even give one star to this shop. The man at the counter (probably the owner) doesn’t care about customers—only money matters to him. You could be unhappy, frustrated, or even cheated… he won’t blink.

I bought a Sequence game thinking I’d get something good. But when I opened the box at home, the board was cheap and the colors were dull—felt like it came from the discount bin. So I went back to return it. And guess what? No return, no exchange, no respect. I wasn’t shocked, but the way he behaved was even worse. Cold, rude, and zero care.

And the best part? He kept the game AND charged me ₹680 for simply opening the box and bringing it back the next day. I left the game there, walked out frustrated, and basically paid him to cheat me.

💡 Tips to avoid getting tricked like I was:

Don’t trust the packaging—open and check before you buy.

Take a friend with you if possible. Some shopkeepers behave differently when not dealing with just one person.

Try buying from places that have good reviews, clear return policies, and basic respect for customers.

Ask questions before buying: What happens if the product is damaged? Can I return or exchange?

⚠️ If you love your hard-earned money, stay far away from shops like this. No one deserves to be treated like this.
